# Deepak Jatav

> Analytics and business intelligence lead in Bengaluru, India. He builds the data warehouse, dashboards and order-to-cash reconciliation for a home-textiles brand selling on Amazon, Noon, Namshi, Trendyol, Home Centre, Centrepoint and its own Zid store across Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

Key facts (figures from his reconciliation portal, November 2026):

- Current role: Senior Data Analyst & Operations Lead at Looms & Berries LLP, Bengaluru, since September 2023. Leads a team of 6 analysts.
- 5+ years in analytics and e-commerce operations; went from intern to lead in about two and a half years at the same company.
- Designed a Google BigQuery warehouse holding 5+ years of sales, ads, inventory and payments data, with automated Looker Studio dashboards on top.
- Built a channel reconciliation portal: 60,000+ orders a year across 9 sales channels reconciled against marketplace settlements and Ginesys ERP; 96% of sales match automatically; 25 data sources; 11 active users.
- Built a price tracker covering 3,000+ SKUs on Amazon KSA and UAE, a B2B ordering app and a company task manager.
- Tools: SQL, Python, Google BigQuery, Power BI, Looker Studio, Excel and Power Query, Tableau, Ginesys ERP, Unicommerce OMS.
- Education: B.Sc. Information Technology, Jiwaji University.

The interactive dashboards on the site use sample data, not company figures.
